_note: Repackages Kasm's prebuilt profile-sync Go binaries from the public S3 (built per-distro; we take the ubuntu_noble build and autoPatchelf it -> distro-independent). Mirrors src/ubuntu/install/profile_sync/install_profile_sync.sh: url = profile-sync/<commit>/<profile_distro>_<branch>_<commit6>_<arch>-kasm-profile-sync[-2]. Ships BOTH versions the boot selects via KASM_PROFILE_LDR (0/1 -> v1 kasm-profile-sync; 2 -> v2 kasm-profile-sync-2, which needs libarchive). arch is the raw uname (x86_64), NOT amd64. Bump: update commit_id/branch/version + hash (nix store prefetch-file <url>).
